scope: Adaptive follow-up after three known omissions. Same frozen rubric, same single unblinded reviewer; not a new independent holdout or a repeatability estimate.

H03.basis: Explicit managed workload identity/runtime secret delivery, no credentials in images/manifests and log redaction now complement compatible additive events, bounded canary, gates and recovery.

H15.basis: Complete copyable offline Python mock preserves the supplied acceptance/polling/retry lifecycle and labels its own representation as non-wire schema. Its pending, duplicate-identity and completed assertions executed successfully; real API compatibility remains untested.

H27.basis: Assumed ABI rules explicitly require nonnull context, null data only at zero length without null slice construction, aligned/live storage and checked arithmetic. Caller provenance/lifetime obligations, allocation pairing, negative-status errors and quiescent teardown are explicit; native execution remains unmeasured.
